reason: RC2 implementation surfaced two schema-linkage omissions in the RC1 text. They were normalized before RC2 certification.

normalizations.resolution: candidate_config_hash is a required top-level field, participates in candidate_identity, and CONFIG/HYBRID-with-CONFIG candidates require an exact projected material-config SHA-256.
Every EXACT_DATASET and FUTURE_DATASET_REQUIREMENT carries a deterministic requirement_id; evaluation identity binds the exact satisfied requirement.

implementation_hardening: CONFIG projection recomputes candidate_config_hash from explicit non-secret material config values.
Evaluation identity validates exact requirement role/domain/authority and exact-dataset binding.
Future dataset evaluation requires external source/config binding proof.
Target-domain semantics are checked against actual proposal components.
